title: Slab cones versus cones: good slab directions forming an orthonormal basis of W^⊥ give the cone trichotomy (Step 3; Dall'Alba Lemma 5.5)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 1, E := ℝ^{n+ℓ}, W ⊆ E an n-dimensional subspace with orthogonal projection P := W.starProjection, u_1, …, u_ℓ orthonormal vectors in W^⊥, and H_j := W ⊔ span{u_j} with orthogonal projection p_j. Let A ⊆ E be any set, δ ∈ ℝ and a ∈ E. Put Z_j(s) := {x : |p_j(x − a) − (p_j(x − a)·u_j)u_j| < s|p_j(x − a)|} and m_j(r, s) := Hⁿ(A ∩ (Z_j(s) ∩ B(a, r))). Suppose that for every j one of the following holds. (Ψ0_j) For every c > 0 there is ε > 0 with m_j(r, s) ≤ c(rs)ⁿ for all 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ. (Ψ∞_j) For every K ∈ ℝ and ε > 0 there are 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ with K(rs)ⁿ ≤ m_j(r, s). (Ax′_j) Some b ∈ A has b ≠ a, |b − a| < δ and p_j(b − a) − (p_j(b − a)·u_j)u_j = 0. Then the cone trichotomy T(a, P) holds for X(r, s) := {x : |P(x − a)| < s|x − a|} ∩ B(a, r): (Φ0) for every c > 0 there is ε > 0 with Hⁿ(A ∩ X(r, s)) ≤ c(rs)ⁿ for all 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ; or (Φ∞) for every K ∈ ℝ and ε > 0 there are 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ with K(rs)ⁿ ≤ Hⁿ(A ∩ X(r, s)); or (Ax) some b ∈ A has b ≠ a, |b − a| < δ and P(b − a) = 0. Hⁿ = μHE[n], and bounds are compared via ENNReal.ofReal.
